introduce.text: A three-digit number has hundreds, tens and ones. Look at 245.

introduce.text: In 245, the 2 means 2 hundreds, the 4 means 4 tens and the 5 means 5 ones. So 245 = 200 + 40 + 5.

demonstrate.text: First the tens and ones. 45 is 4 tens and 5 ones.

demonstrate.text: Now put 3 hundreds in front: 345 = 300 + 40 + 5. A zero holds a place, so 308 = 300 + 0 + 8: no tens.

lessons.title: Skip counting and patterns
lessons.objective: Find the next number in a skip-counting pattern.
